rules.statement: When a changelog entry describes a behavior that comes from shared code or a shared included rule, credit it to every command or component that uses that shared piece, or describe it generally, not just the one that prompted the change.
rules.why: Crediting a shared behavior to a single consumer gives readers the wrong idea of which commands behave this way.
rules.check: For each changelog entry that names one command or component, check whether the changed logic lives in a shared file that other commands also include or call. If it does, flag the entry when it names only one of them.
